data.summary: European Commission Press release Damascus, 17 Nov 2026 Today, the Syria Partnership Coordination Forum (SPCF) convened in Damascus for the first time to advance Syria's recovery and reconstruction, showcase investment opportunities and agree on concrete steps forward.

data.title: European Commission: Commission approves amended German State aid schemes for energy-intensive companies
data.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 17 Nov 2026 The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, Germany's amended schemes to compensate energy-intensive companies for indirect emission costs under the EU Emission Trading System (EU ETS) and for temporary electricity price relief under the Clean Industrial Deal State aid Framework (CISAF) and Middle East Crisis Temporary State Aid Framework (METSAF).
